units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 2:1:3">Y. Yoma II, beg. 39ᵇ</cite> <he>יצא זה שהוא בה׳</he> this (service) is excluded, since it consists only of removing (the ashes). Ib. 39ᶜ; a. fr.
